highlights: Listen to your favorite music for a long time without feeling uncomfortable.
Havit H628BT are distinguished by their long working time, and they will only take 30 minutes to charge.
What's more, the soft earcups fit snugly around your ears and provide comfort.
Moreover, you can use them both wirelessly and wired - the set includes an audio cable.
The headphones weigh only 116 g, and the ear cups are made of soft and skin-friendly material.
What's more, they fit snugly around the ears, while not causing uncomfortable pressure. In turn, the foldable design makes it easy to store and transport.

Don't be afraid of interference and connection problems. The headphones connect to a compatible device via Bluetooth 5.1, providing fast and stable signal transmission of up to 10 meters. However, if you rely on traditional solutions or fear that the headphones will go flat in a while, use the 3.5 mm cable (included).
With its help you can connect the Havit H628BT, for example, to your computer - enjoy your favorite music without interference.
Havit H628BT uses a 200 mAh battery, which translates into about 9 hours of playback or talk time.
